• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.

Health insurance

Dental Plan

Life insurance

Transportation vouchers

Childcare assistance

Gympass

title: Senior DevOps Engineer
description:
Would you like to partake in technical challenges, collaborate on an interesting product, be up to date with the latest technology, and contribute to taking our product to market? Then keep reading!


Yes, tell me more…

fullinfo is a startup B2B data services software company.

We are building an un-paralleled data collection pipeline which is being deployed on AWS and written in Go and Typescript. With a focus on innovation, quality, and accessibility, we are developing a one-stop lead generator platform.

The Customer facing part of the solution is a Typescript and GraphQL based web application. Deployed on AWS as well. Serverless paradigm is being applied: Most of our code is running as AWS’s Lambda’s.


We are currently hiring a Senior DevOps Engineer with AWS CDK knowledge for an initial 12-month B2B Contract on a remote basis. The ideal candidate will be comfortable with AWS (EDA architecture) and TypeScript and willing to pick up new technologies as needed.


Responsibilities:

  • Participate in our DevOps team
  • Ensure the quality of our AWS infrastructure
  • Develop and review infrastructure code that enhances performance and cost efficiency
  • Ensure seamless integration of all AWS services within our architecture
  • Optimize the infrastructure for continuous scalability
  • Drive ongoing improvements in CI/CD pipelines
  • Collaborate with development teams, the CTO, and technical leads


Requirements:

  • A Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or related field
  • A minimum of 6 years relevant experience working in DevOps roles
  • Hands-on experience with TypeScript and AWS CDK
  • Coding experience in implementing business features
  • Familiarity with AWS services, including Lambda, API Gateway, S3, CloudFront, EventBridge, AppSync, DynamoDb, OpenSearch
  • Business-level proficiency in English


The successful candidate will…

  • Be comfortable working remotely and independently, with some overlap with HQ work schedule
  • Take ownership and be accountable for their work
  • Be eager to work on various aspects of our cloud infrastructure in a generalist role
  • Quickly familiarize themselves with our infrastructure to generate new ideas and improve our existing setup
  • Have experience supporting other teams in implementing AWS solutions
  • Adopt a proactive, hands-on approach


What can you expect from us?

  • To shape the company from the ground up – join our team as a pioneer and help us carve our way forward.
  • Together we’ll take our product to market – how cool would it be to celebrate together?A flat hierarchical structure with room for innovation in a highly motivated team.
  • A start-up environment that is passionate about quality, problem solving and building beautiful software.


Our passion stems from our shared values and mission. With that said, our culture is built on two major aspects:

Quality: At fullinfo we have show-and-tell energy, and we let the quality of our product speak for itself. We love building beautiful software and get hyped by always raising the bar on quality. Our product is beautiful inside and outside. How do we achieve this? By always asking ourselves “Is this right?” or “Does this make sense?”.

Problem Solving: We foster innovation and novel approaches to problem solving, while keeping user needs at front of mind.

title: Desenvolvedor(a) SAP Full Stack - PL/SR
description:
We Transform. SAP® Solutions into Value


A transformação digital ajuda as empresas a atingirem seu potencial máximo - se as tecnologias funcionarem para as pessoas que as utilizam! A NTT DATA Business Solutions está há 30 anos no mercado mundial. Somos uma empresa apaixonada por transformação. E queremos transformar o mundo e as pessoas através das soluções que criamos juntos com nossos parceiros. Aqui projetamos, implementamos, gerenciamos e potencializamos continuamente as soluções SAP para fazê-las funcionar para as empresas – e para as pessoas.


Fazemos parte do grupo NTT DATA – um dos 10 maiores provedores de tecnologia do mundo – segundo o Gartner, e juntos somos mais de 130.000 colaboradores espalhados em 53 países. Nossa meta é impactar positivamente o mundo ajudando a criar uma sociedade mais conectada, diversa e criativa.


Buscamos um(a) profissional SAP FullStack (Pleno ou Sênior) para atuar em ambientes SAP S/4HANA, com foco em desenvolvimento moderno utilizando o modelo RAP e aplicações Fiori. A posição envolve atuação ponta a ponta, desde a camada de dados e serviços até a interface, colaborando com arquitetos e consultores funcionais em times ágeis ou híbridos.


Principais Responsabilidades


  • Desenvolver soluções SAP FullStack no ambiente S/4HANA.
  • Implementar serviços utilizando o modelo RAP (RESTful ABAP Programming Model).
  • Criar e manter CDS Views (projection, exposure e behavior) e Behavior Definitions.
  • Desenvolver Service Definitions e Service Bindings com exposição via OData V4.
  • Construir aplicações com Fiori Elements.
  • Atuar com ABAP OO seguindo boas práticas de Clean Code e qualidade de código.
  • Realizar revisões de código e aplicar padrões de qualidade e sustentabilidade técnica.
  • Trabalhar de forma colaborativa com arquitetos, consultores funcionais e times ágeis.


Requisitos:


  • Experiência prática com SAP S/4HANA.
  • Domínio do modelo RAP.
  • Conhecimento sólido em ABAP Orientado a Objetos.
  • Boa comunicação e capacidade de atuação em times ágeis ou híbridos.
  • Mentalidade orientada a Clean Code, qualidade e manutenção evolutiva.


Diferenciais (Desejável):


  • Participação em pelo menos uma implementação greenfield de SAP S/4HANA.
  • Experiência com ATC, SCI ou outras ferramentas de qualidade de código.
  • Certificações SAP.
  • Inglês intermediário/ avançado.


Regime de contratação: CLT

100% Remoto no Brasil

Viagens pontoais (2-3 vezes ao ano)


Liberte todo o seu potencial e engenhosidade – molde o seu próprio futuro. Somos mais do que apenas um local de trabalho; somos uma incubadora de talentos. Com diversos caminhos e oportunidades de aprendizado e carreira de longo prazo, oferecemos inúmeras maneiras de realizar seus sonhos.

title: Graphic Designer
description:
About the Product

For more than 30 years, Carnegie has been a leader and innovator in higher education marketing and enrollment strategy, offering groundbreaking services in the areas of Research, Strategy, Digital Marketing, Lead Generation, Slate Optimization, Student Search, Website Development, and Creative that generate authentic connections.


Job Purpose

A Designer on the Content & Engagement team is a skilled strategic thinker who is responsible for crafting highly branded and conversion-optimized creative across the divisions of Carnegie.


Duties and Responsibilities

  • Team Leadership
  • Work with team leaders and colleagues across Carnegie to optimize the team’s efficiency and effectiveness by identifying possible improvements to workflow, and scheduling
  • Champion project collaboration, working to motivate team members and ensure smooth and proactive interactions and processes
  • Design Development
  • Formulate clear and thoughtful content strategies to meet organizational objectives
  • Move design strategies to action, creating high-quality, highly branded, cohesive design constructs across communication channels (print, web, social, video, etc.) that tell a compelling story
  • Foster a collaborative, solutions-oriented culture that champions client success
  • Cross-Divisional Strategy
  • Facilitate knowledge sharing as necessary to ensure that campaign strategy is understood.
  • Be well-versed in translating performance metrics into actionable takeaways
  • Represent content decisions on client discovery and presentation calls with clarity, confidence, and professionalism
  • Optimization & Innovation
  • Analyze conversion metrics to understand what resonates with audiences and drive content iteration
  • Contribute to innovations and improvements in client-facing products and services as well as internal processes
  • Foster a culture of innovation and creative problem-solving by staying up-to-date on industry trends, emerging technologies, and marketing best practices


Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

  • Excellent organizational and highly developed collaboration, problem-solving, and project management skills to thrive in a fast-paced work environment with a large client portfolio
  • Ability to think outside the box to develop bold and innovative storytelling strategies while developing differentiated, compelling, and original creative work
  • Public speaking skills for high levels of client interaction and ability to listen carefully and navigate organizational politics
  • Consistent ability to critically evaluate the quality of creative work and guide revisions while coaching the best creative work from colleagues and direct reports
  • Thorough knowledge of creative tools, including Adobe, Microsoft Office Suite, and Google Office
  • Competency in prompt engineering and utilizing Artificial Intelligence tools, such as ChatGPT and Generative AI, throughout the creative process
  • Effective communication and time management skills for a remote work environment as well as the ability to use/learn multiple technology platforms and switch between them on a regular basis
  • Must be able to work at a computer for prolonged periods
  • Thorough knowledge of print and digital communication development to effectively work across media
  • Due to the remote environment, effective communication and time management skills are required, as well as the ability to use/learn multiple technology platforms and switch between them on a regular basis
  • Physical requirement: Must be able to work at a computer for prolonged periods


Credentials and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in Graphic Design, Fine Arts, or related field
  • 3 or more years of professional graphic design experience
  • Robust portfolio of design samples and case studies that demonstrate measurable success


We offer

  • We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team.
  • Flexible Paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) and flexible work schedule.
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health and wellness package.
  • Fully remote.

title: Revenue Operations Associate
description:
About Us:

YipitData is the leading market research and analytics firm for the disruptive economy and most recently raised $475M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation of over $1B. Every day, our proprietary technology analyzes billions of alternative data points to uncover actionable insights across sectors like software, AI, cloud, e-commerce, ridesharing, and payments.

Our data and research teams transform raw data into strategic intelligence, delivering accurate, timely, and deeply contextualized analysis that our customers—ranging from the world’s top investment funds to Fortune 500 companies—depend on to drive high-stakes decisions. From sourcing and licensing novel datasets to rigorous analysis and expert narrative framing, our teams ensure clients get not just data, but clarity and confidence.

We operate globally with offices in the US (NYC, Austin, Miami, Mountain View), APAC (Hong Kong, Shanghai, Beijing, Guangzhou, Singapore), and India. Our award-winning, people-centric culture—recognized by Inc. as a Best Workplace for three consecutive years—emphasizes transparency, ownership, and continuous mastery.

What It’s Like to Work at YipitData:

YipitData isn’t a place for coasting—it’s a launchpad for ambitious, impact-driven professionals.

From day one, you’ll take the lead on meaningful work, accelerate your growth, and gain exposure that shapes careers.

Why Top Talent Chooses YipitData:

  • Ownership That Matters : You’ll lead high-impact projects with real business outcomes
  • Rapid Growth : We compress years of learning into months
  • Merit Over Titles : Trust and responsibility are earned through execution, not tenure
  • Velocity with Purpose: We move fast, support each other, and aim high—always with purpose and intention

If your ambition is matched by your work ethic—and you’re hungry for a place where growth, impact, and ownership are the norm—YipitData might be the opportunity you’ve been waiting for.


About SpendHound:

  • SpendHound is a 100% free software renewal management platform and service recently launched by the research firm YipitData. (See this introductory video from SpendHound’s Senior Product Manager!)
  • SpendHound is the single source of truth for companies’ renewal information and includes:
  • A comprehensive view of all software applications used with annual contract values, auto-renewal information, renewal dates, license counts, and more
  • An invoice and contract management system for companies to store their invoices and contracts
  • Renewal reminders through email and Slack so companies never miss upcoming software renewals
  • Free advice from procurement experts to discuss price benchmarking insights and negotiation strategies for any upcoming renewals
  • Companies use the SpendHound platform and procurement expert service to save time and money on their software renewals.
  • SpendHound is free for customers because customer data is de-identified, aggregated with other panelists, and used as part of YipitData market research (example report ).


About The Role:

Are you a collaborative consulting, analytics, or operations professional with 3+ years of experience, passionate about building a world-class revenue team?

We are seeking a Revenue Operations Associate to play a crucial role in our fast-growing team, SpendHound. As a fast-growing “start-up” within a larger organization, this is a unique opportunity for someone with a strong operational mindset to come in and help build something truly special.


We expect East work hours.


As our Revenue Operations Associate, you will partner with our Sales and Marketing teams to:

  • Be an operations subject matter expert for the Sales function, working closely with RevOps and Spendhound leadership to support Sales and execute on key initiatives
  • Implement processes and solutions that can streamline revenue acquisition and eliminate inefficiencies
  • Maintain and measure various components of the Sales process, such as
  • Target/Territory Management
  • Lead Generation, and
  • Outbound Cadence Operations.
  • Ensure that the Sales teams are operating seamlessly through data evaluation and by improving workflows


You Are Likely To Succeed If:

  • Operations professional with 3+ years of experience, passionate about building a world-class revenue team.
  • You demonstrate a high aptitude for organization, process development, project and change management, and analytics
  • You have advanced Excel skills
  • Your experience with CRMs such as Salesforce.com
  • You are willing to become proficient in SQL and data management
  • You are a natural problem-solver, with a keen eye for detail and spotting issues
  • You are committed to continuously improving yourself and helping those around you


What We Offer:

  • Flexible PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits)
  • Flexible work schedule
  • Personal laptop
  • Health and wellness package
  • Remote work
  • Your growth at YipitData is determined by the impact that you are making, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at YipitData is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust. See more on our high-impact, high-opportunity work environment above!

Candidates must have primary residency (and be physically located) in the country of hire (AKA Brazil) in order to be considered for the position. If hired, the worker must maintain primary residency in the country of hire in order to be eligible for employment.


We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer.

title: Investment Manager (Paid Consultancy Opportunity)
description:
Company - RONIN International is an independent B2B market research company specialising in business, healthcare and tech studies. We are part of the Rippleffect Group (formerly Fat Media Group) and are Company Partners of The Market Research Society (MRS), Corporate Members of ESOMAR, Members of the Insights Association and Council Members of The Interviewer Quality Control Scheme (IQCS).



About - We are looking to speak with Investment decision makers such as Investment Manager, Portfolio Manager, Financial Advisor or Analyst who are working in investment bank, private equity firms, asset management firms or family offices.



Qualifications:

  • The purpose of this study is to gain an understanding of the global awareness of city’s attractiveness in trade, investment and partnership. I believe your opinions and expertise would be valuable for our study and I wonder if you’re interested in taking part.
  • Job titles: Head of Investment, Portfolio Manager or Investment Manager, Wealth Manager, Wealth Advisor, Analyst.
  • The paid consultancy session will be conducted as an informal 30-minute interview conducted via MS Teams and the interview can be held in either English or Portuguese.
  • Please note that, before the final interview, there'll be a 10-minute quick online screener to share more details on the research and to check that this is relevant to you.


Compensation package - BRL 1100 for a 30-minute online interview.

title: SDR Viagens Internacional - Sênior
description:
SDR Viagens Internacional - Sênior — LUA DE MEL & EXPERIÊNCIAS PERSONALIZADAS (BRASIL)


A Honeymooners é uma agência internacional especializada em luas de mel e viagens de alto valor , com forte presença no mercado dos Estados Unidos.


Esta não é uma vaga de call center nem de agendamento mecânico.

Buscamos um(a) SDR SÊNIOR , com experiência real em vendas consultivas, capaz de criar conexão humana imediata e abrir o caminho certo para uma venda premium.


Estamos fortalecendo o topo do funil internacional e procuramos alguém que entenda que velocidade, qualidade do primeiro contato e leitura de intenção fazem toda a diferença .


O que você vai fazer:

• Ser o primeiro contato humano com casais internacionais que solicitam informações sobre a lua de mel;

• Entrar em contato rapidamente após o pedido (tempo de resposta é crítico);

• Criar uma conexão inicial de confiança e entusiasmo;

• Qualificar momento, intenção e expectativas do casal;

• Agendar reuniões qualificadas com os(as) consultores(as) de viagens;

• Garantir follow-ups consistentes e bem estruturados;

• Registrar contexto, histórico e interações no CRM.

Você não fará orçamentos nem fechará vendas.

Seu foco é conexão, clareza e agendamento de alta qualidade .


Procuramos alguém que:

• Tenha experiência comprovada como SDR ou em vendas consultivas;

**Please note that we're aiming at an expatriation to Portugal**


We are a Portuguese technology consulting company with a strong outward look to the rest of Europe. We have 12 years of experience in the market and reached the status of “large company” in 2018. We now have more than 350 associates and we keep growing, with offices in Lisbon, Porto, and Leiria , as well as projects in more than 20 countries. Our company is part of the national top 10, with a growth of 250% in the last years.


Work-life balance is part of our DNA. We focus on win-win-win relationships, defining every moment of interaction as an experience with unique conditions. #welcometoyourfuture

  • College degree in IT Engineering or similar areas;
  • At least 3 years of relevant professional experience in Java programming language ;
  • A strong experience with front end technologies (Angular OR React.JS for example)
  • Experience with microservice architecture and cloud is a BIG plus;
  • Experience with Spring frameworks;
  • Good level of English (minimum B2 level)
  • Availability to relocate and live in Portugal with our support;


What we expect from you

  • Will to exceed expectations (your own and the ones defined by Affinity);
  • Exceptional skills and the will to acquire more;
  • Good people skills (not just in terms of technology, language, and platforms), team spirit, and pleasant disposition;

  • Versatility (you can be a fan of BYOD or not);

What will encourage you

  • Being part of a company that has a disruptive action in the technology market;
  • Being part of a technology focused on relationships, simplicity, and efficiency;
  • Accessing a generative career directly proportional to your performance and interest;
  • The real possibility of being part of our company staff.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
We're Hiring: Senior Data Engineer | Remote from Brazil | Fluent English required |


Location : Remote – Brazil only

Contact: Temporary


Are you passionate about building scalable data platforms and cutting-edge MLOps solutions? Do you want to work with a top-tier US company revolutionizing e-commerce and circular fashion?

We're looking for a Senior Data Engineer with strong MLOps expertise to join our growing data engineering team. This is a full-time , 100% remote opportunity exclusive to candidates located in Brazil . You'll be working with a fast-paced US-based company, leading innovations in sustainable commerce and data-driven operations.


What You’ll Do


  • Design, develop, and maintain robust, scalable data infrastructure across real-time and batch workloads.
  • Build and support ML pipelines for model training, deployment, and monitoring.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with data scientists, engineers, and product teams to deliver high-performance data and ML solutions.
  • Develop APIs and services for data ingestion, transformation, and querying.
  • Ensure the reliability of ML systems through strong observability and operational tools.
  • Contribute to architectural decisions and mentor team members.


Tech Stack & Requirements


  • 5+ years as a Data Engineer or MLOps Engineer.
  • Strong experience with Python , Java , or Scala .
  • Hands-on with GCP (preferred), AWS or Azure .
  • Experience with BigQuery , ML frameworks (TensorFlow, PyTorch), and container orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Familiarity with Apache Kafka , Spark , or similar tools is a big plus.
  • Experience with ETL , CI/CD , git , and monitoring pipelines .
  • Strong communication skills and fluency in English (written & spoken) is mandatory .
  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or related fields.


What We Offer


  • Top-tier hourly rate paid in USD
  • Long-term contract opportunity
  • Fully remote work – collaborate with international teams from the comfort of your home
  • A high-impact role within a data-driven, mission-oriented company

title: Desenvolvedor(a) Full Stack IA
description:
Quer crescer junto com uma empresa que está transformando a educação com tecnologia e IA?


Se você gosta de desenvolver aplicações modernas, tem curiosidade por Inteligência Artificial, e quer trabalhar em um time que está criando agentes de IA e soluções inteligentes no Azure, essa vaga pode ser para você!


Estamos em busca de um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) Full Stack IA para fortalecer nossa nova área de AI Solutions e ajudar a construir soluções baseadas em IA Generativa, automações e integrações inteligentes.


Como será a sua contribuição no time:


  • Desenvolver agentes de IA, aplicações e APIs com foco em IA Generativa (agentes conversacionais, análise de sentimentos, tradução, sumarização, automações).
  • Implementar lógica e fluxos de agentes de IA, ajustando prompts e comportamentos conforme diferentes cenários de uso.
  • Integrar modelos de IA (LLMs) às aplicações utilizando APIs, SDKs e bibliotecas especializadas.
  • Construir e manter microsserviços escaláveis, com atenção à performance e boas práticas.
  • Apoiar o monitoramento e a evolução das soluções de IA em produção, garantindo estabilidade e confiabilidade.
  • Trabalhar de forma colaborativa com áreas de produto, engenharia e IA, participando ativamente das decisões técnicas.


Se você… já tem experiência como desenvolvedor(a) full stack, curiosidade por IA e vontade de aprender e crescer em um ambiente colaborativo e inovador — essa oportunidade pode ser sua!


Requisitos mínimos:


  • Experiência em desenvolvimento frontend (React ou Vue, CSS, JavaScript/TypeScript).
  • Experiência em desenvolvimento backend (Node.js e/ou Python).
  • Desenvolvimento e consumo de APIs REST.
  • Experiência ou forte interesse em integração com serviços de IA/LLMs (OpenAI, Azure OpenAI).
  • Criação e otimização de prompts para agentes de IA.
  • Conhecimento em Git para versionamento de código (Azure DevOps ou GitHub).
  • Experiência com bancos de dados e serviços como:
  • Azure SQL e Supabase (PostgreSQL, Auth, Storage, Realtime)


Diferenciais que contam pontos:


  • Experiência com frameworks como LangChain, Semantic Kernel, Microsoft Agent Framework ou similares.
  • Vivência com Azure Functions, arquitetura serverless ou integrações com APIs externas.
  • Conhecimento em Redis para cache ou filas.
  • Interesse ou experiência com Azure AI Foundry.
  • Experiência com desenvolvimento assistido por IA (Vibe Coding), utilizando ferramentas como: GitHub Copilot, Cursor AI, Claude Code, etc..
  • Ter atuado em startups ou empresas de tecnologia.


O que você vai encontrar aqui:


  • Um ambiente colaborativo, com aprendizado contínuo.
  • Projetos reais com IA aplicada a problemas do dia a dia.
  • Stack moderna e liberdade para experimentar e evoluir.
  • Participação direta na construção de uma nova área estratégica da empresa.
  • Oportunidade de crescimento técnico e profissional.

title: Hiring: Portuguese Language Dubbing Artist
description:
Company Description

Sukudo Studios is Asia's leading provider of localization services for the media and entertainment sector. Renowned for partnering with globally recognized entertainment studios and streaming platforms, Sukudo Studios offers a comprehensive range of services, including dubbing, subtitling, accessibility, media management, and content transformation in over 50 languages. With years of industry expertise and cutting-edge facilities, the company ensures a seamless blend of creative and technical excellence. Sukudo Studios is committed to making content accessible worldwide while maintaining a strong focus on customer satisfaction. Visit sukudostudios.com for more information and updates.


Role Description

  • Strong professional proficiency in Portuguese
  • Prior experience in drama dubbing and/or voice-over performance.
  • Strong understanding of emotion, tone, lip-sync timing, and cultural adaptation.
  • Ability to deliver high-quality, natural-sounding voice performance aligned with character and context.
  • Experience in similar localization and dubbing projects is preferred.


Qualifications

  • Excellent command of Portuguese pronunciation, fluency, and expressive delivery (emotion, pacing, intensity).
  • Proven experience in voice acting, dubbing, or narration for films/series/short-form content.
  • Ability to follow direction and maintain character consistency across episodes/scenes.
  • Familiarity with audio recording processes and basic knowledge of audio editing tools is a plus.
  • Strong professionalism: ability to meet deadlines, take feedback, and collaborate with creative/project teams.
  • Prior exposure to localization workflows or media/entertainment industry projects is advantageous.
  • Degree or certification in Languages, Communication, Performing Arts, or related fields is preferred but not mandatory.

title: Desenvolvedor(a) Dynamics 365
description:
Especialistas em tecnologias e plataformas para gestão para negócios, somos reconhecidamente, uma das principais provedoras de soluções Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM no Brasil.

Com foco na inovação e comprometidos com a qualidade, nossos projetos já ajudaram muitas empresas a mudarem o futuro das pessoas.

Nossa cultura está baseada em entregar inovação e criatividade com alta performance trazendo para o time, profissionais que possuam espírito inovador, alma empreendedora e obsessão em evoluir.

Então, vamos realizar juntos?

Estamos em busca de talentos que queiram fazer parte de histórias transformacionais.


Suas principais atividades e atribuições estarão ligadas ao desenvolvimento de plug-ins, APIs, integrações e parametrizações na plataforma.

title: Video Ad & Digital Ad Designer Specialist
description:
Please only apply if you are really a 'full stack' designer with a variety of seasoned skills including design video ads AND digital display ads that are graphic intensive


Are you a dedicated, resourceful team player with strong creative skills and a portfolio of work which demonstrates passion for UX design? Do you have experience working with numerous different design platforms especially in digital form, especially Adobe Creative Suite? Have you made eye-catching animated digital ads? Have you made social media video ads with AI characters like HeyGen and searched for stock video and audio footage based on the sales scripts?


Submission of video and digital ad design portfolio REQUIRED to be considered for the position. We expect to see real animation effects (not stock videos with text layovers).


See a real work sample spec here. If your portfolio is selected, then we will offer you to do a paid work test based on this exact spec.


About Us

Life Water Media specializes in digital branding and awareness campaigns for publicly traded companies and other large scale projects. We started in 2019.


Responsibilities

  • Handle multiple graphic projects from start to finish, adhering to set deadlines set by Creative Director.
  • Create eye-catching display ads with animation on creatopy.com that stimulate visitors from Facebook, Google, etc
  • Review success of ads and suggest updates and new ads styles.
  • Open to using additional apps such as midjourney.com (unique ai images), creatopy.com (for automated ad sizing), (additional landing page platform, similar to Elementor), capcut, etc.
  • Able to make TikTok and Youtube ad video shorts based on sales scripts with stock video and audio


Qualifications

  • Proficient in Adobe Creative Suite
  • Strong communication, conceptual thinking, typography skills and design skills
  • HTML/CSS design
  • Deadline and detail-oriented
  • Self Starter who can be self-taught and work without much direction
  • Works well in collaboration with a team and independently.
  • Must have excellent grammar skills
  • Must have the ability to multitask, work in a busy environment just as good as in solitude. This position requires a personality that can accept constructive criticism, change directions rapidly and accept new assignments frequently with pressing deadlines.


Compensation

Salary: based on your experience level

Bonuses: Performance and team share bonuses


To Apply Submit:

  • Current resume
  • Synopsis of recent salary history
  • Portfolio of your digital media work ranging from ads to video ads.


Requirements Before Employment

  • Short paid test project showcasing landing page, video and digital ads to assess work quality with our spec
  • Signed Independent Contractor Agreement and w8-Ben (USA tax form for International)


Company Culture

  • Remote
  • We're playful, tight nit, friendly, family-oriented atmosphere.
company: TD Media LLC (dba Life Water Media)

title: Gerente de Processos e Excelência Operacional
description:
A SWM International é uma multinacional produtora de papéis para indústria do tabaco e soluções em papéis especiais.


Somos fabricantes especializados de uma variedade de materiais avançados, presentes no dia a dia das pessoas. Nós fazemos parte do seu dia com nossos produtos de qualidade e colaboramos com nossos clientes para fornecer soluções inovadoras e personalizadas para aumentar o valor de seus produtos.


Agora, queremos convidar você a fazer parte do nosso dia a dia, onde cada colaborador é essencial para o sucesso da nossa empresa.

Traga o seu talento para a SWM!


Estamos buscando um(a) Gerente de Processos e Excelência Operacional para atuar em uma posição permanente na nossa Unidade em Piraí, no Rio de Janeiro.


Responsabilidades Principais:

  • Gestão da rotina operacional:

Garantir a execução dos padrões operacionais

Acompanhar indicadores de performance (KPIs)

Conduzir reuniões de performance e atuar sobre desvios


  • Gestão e desenvolvimento de equipe:

Direcionar atividades, desenvolver competências e acompanhar resultados

Estimular a cultura de melhoria contínua e excelência operacional


  • Gestão de processos e projetos:

Mapear, padronizar e otimizar processos (BPMN, POPs, KPIs)

Liderar projetos Lean, Kaizen e iniciativas de melhoria contínua

Sustentar a governança dos processos operacionais


  • Controle de custos e eficiência:

Analisar consumos, perdas e desperdícios

Definir e acompanhar ações de redução de custos

Validar ganhos e apoiar o orçamento com dados de produtividade


Requisitos Mínimos:

  • Formação acadêmica

Superior completo em Engenharia Química ou áreas afins

Desejável pós-graduação ou MBA em Gestão de Projetos ou Gestão de Negócios


  • Experiência profissional

Mínimo de 7 anos de experiência em ambiente industrial

Vivência em processos e/ou produção, preferencialmente na indústria de Papel e Celulose

Experiência com excelência operacional e melhoria contínua


  • Conhecimentos técnicos

Processos industriais e funcionamento de máquinas de papel

Lean Six Sigma (DMAIC, Kaizen, 5S, FMEA, Ishikawa, CEP)

Certificação Green Belt ou Black Belt (desejável)

Gestão de Processos (BPMN, POPs, KPIs, análise de gargalos)

Gestão de Projetos (PMBOK, Agile, gestão de riscos e stakeholders)

Análise de dados e sistemas: Power BI, DCS/QCS, MES, ERP (ex.: SAP)

Normas de Segurança, Meio Ambiente e Qualidade (ISO 9001, 14001, 45001)


  • Idiomas

Inglês: avançado

Espanhol: Intermediário


  • O que temos para você:

Salário atrativo conforme mercado


Benefícios:

  • Plano de Saúde: SUL AMÉRICA – Familiar – sem coparticipação - Abrangência nacional (titular mensal gratuito)
  • Assistência Oftalmológica: Reembolso de até R$ 517,00 (armações e lentes) por ano.
  • Seguro de Vida em Grupo: Seguro Sul América, com participação mensal do funcionário por meio de desconto em folha de pagamento.
  • Plano Odontológico: Amil 700, familiar, com abrangência nacional.
  • Previdência privada
  • Ticket de Natal
  • Ticket Refeição
  • Alimentação no Local – Restaurante Próprio
  • Ticket farmácia
  • Auxílio Transporte
  • Brinquedo - filhos até 12 anos
  • Bônus conforme atingimento de metas


Seu horário de trabalho será:

Turno Administrativo

Localização: Santanésia – Piraí/RJ

Modelo de trabalho: Presencial

* Todas as nossas vagas também são destinadas a pessoas com deficiência ;)

title: Senior Application Developer
description:
Senior Application Developer – AI Course Bots

100% Remote | Long-Term Contract | EST Working Hours

About the Role

Our client is seeking an experienced Senior Application Developer to help build next-generation AI-powered course bots using generative AI technologies on AWS Cloud .

This role will play a key part in transforming business education through intelligent, interactive, and scalable learning experiences.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design and develop enterprise-grade AI course bots with a focus on scalability, performance, extensibility, and system integration.
  • Implement the technical vision of the course bot platform using appropriate AI models, APIs, and AWS cloud services .
  • Collaborate closely with faculty, product managers, and ed-tech experts to translate educational requirements into technical solutions.
  • Build secure, robust, and scalable cloud-native solutions on AWS for bot deployment and operations.
  • Follow best practices in AI-focused software development , including coding standards, code reviews, and testing methodologies.
  • Integrate cutting-edge generative AI technologies to keep the platform at the forefront of educational innovation.
  • Implement data ingestion, storage, and retrieval pipelines to support AI model workflows.
  • Ensure seamless integration with Learning Management Systems (LMS) and other digital platforms.
  • Implement monitoring, logging, and analytics to track bot performance, usage patterns, and learning outcomes.
  • Enforce security, privacy, and compliance standards , including FERPA and educational data protection requirements.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to align technical delivery with business goals and user experience.
  • Stay updated on emerging trends in AI, cloud computing, and educational technology and recommend innovative enhancements.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent) in Computer Science, Software Engineering , or related field.
  • 5+ years of professional software development experience, primarily with cloud-native applications .
  • Strong experience with serverless architectures, microservices, and event-driven systems .
  • Hands-on experience with Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) , including GraphRAG and contextual retrieval .
  • Experience with generative AI evaluation frameworks .
  • Experience with multi-agent frameworks such as AutoGen, LangGraph , or similar tools.
  • Strong knowledge of AWS services , especially:
  • AI/ML: SageMaker, Bedrock
  • Serverless: Lambda, Step Functions
  • Data: S3, DynamoDB, RDS
  • Strong production-level coding skills in Python and JavaScript / TypeScript .
  • Experience building AI/NLP applications using pre-trained and autoregressive LLMs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Cohere, Google, etc.).
  • Experience designing and implementing RESTful APIs and GraphQL services .
  • Familiarity with DevOps practices , including CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, and automated testing.
  • Solid understanding of data security, privacy, and compliance in educational environments.
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Experience working in Agile development environments .

Preferred Qualifications

  • Background in educational technology or e-learning platforms .
  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, AWS CDK).
  • Advanced understanding of LLMs and machine learning algorithms .
  • Contributions to open-source projects or academic research .
  • Knowledge of modern front-end frameworks such as React or Vue.js and backend integration.

  • Implement data ingestion, storage, and retrieval pipelines to support AI model workflows.

  • Implement monitoring, logging, and analytics to track bot performance, usage patterns, and learning outcomes.
  • Enforce security, privacy, and compliance standards , including FERPA and educational data protection requirements.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent) in Computer Science, Software Engineering , or related field.
  • 5+ years of professional software development experience, primarily with cloud-native applications .

  • Strong production-level coding skills in Python and JavaScript / TypeScript .

  • Familiarity with DevOps practices , including CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, and automated testing.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, AWS CDK).
  • Advanced understanding of LLMs and machine learning algorithms .
  • Contributions to open-source projects or academic research .
  • Knowledge of modern front-end frameworks such as React or Vue.js and backend integration.

title: Devops Engineer (Projeto Internacional)
description:
Se você busca uma oportunidade na área de Tecnologia da Informação, tem organização, boa comunicação e vontade de crescer, essa vaga 100% remoto e CLT, pode ser para você.


Requisitos Técnicos:

  • Experiência sólida com DevOps atuando com Saas/PaaS e plataformas de serviços;
  • Experiência com CI/CD, plataforma Azure (Kubernetes / SQL / AppGW / Key Vault);
  • Experiência com Jira e distribuição Linux;
  • Experiência com suporte operacional por meio de solução de problemas e análise de erros, garantindo o registro e monitoramento eficientes e solução de problemas confiável;
  • Idioma Inglês Avançado (terá inteirações internacionais).


Responsabilidades:

Esse profissional será responsável por provisionar, configurar e manter ambientes em nuvem, utilizando ferramentas (principalmente plataforma Azure) para garantir escalabilidade, estabilidade e segurança dos sistemas.

Além disso, é essencial o domínio em administração de sistemas Linux, com conhecimento em roteamento, estratégias de firewall e gestão de certificados. O profissional também atuará no suporte operacional, realizando análises de erros e troubleshooting, assegurando que os ambientes estejam corretamente logados, monitorados e performando de forma eficiente. Ter conhecimento ou interesse em práticas de CI/CD é valorizado, assim como disposição para trabalhar com ferramentas colaborativas como SharePoint e Jira.

Buscamos alguém com perfil proativo, analítico e orientado à automação, que contribua ativamente para a melhoria contínua dos processos e da infraestrutura


O que oferecemos:

  • Ambiente colaborativo e multicultural.
  • Oportunidade de desenvolvimento profissional em uma das líderes globais em tecnologia.
  • Pacote de benefícios completo - PLR, VR, Gympass, Previdência, Convênios, etc.

title: Desenvolvedor de Firmware Sr
description:
Desenvolvedor de Firmware Sr - Foco em Microcontroladores | 100% Remota | CLT


Sobre nós e Resumo da posição

A Control iD é uma indústria brasileira, especializada no desenvolvimento de relógio de ponto, controle de acesso e equipamentos para automação comercial. Aqui você terá a chance de criar soluções que conectam +300 mil dispositivos IoT e impactam +1 milhão de usuários ativos, em um ambiente que valoriza inovação e liberdade tecnológica.


Buscamos um Desenvolvedor de Firmware Sr para fazer parte da nossa equipe de Engenharia (focado em microcontroladores). Nossa empresa passa por um momento de crescimento e temos a missão de desenvolver novos talentos em nossa equipe. O cargo pretende desenvolver nossos produtos.


O que buscamos (obrigatórios):

  • Senioridade comprovada em embarcados
  • Experiência com ESP32 + ESP-IDF em produção
  • Domínio de C/C++
  • Experiência com RTOS, com destaque para FreeRTOS
  • Git no dia a dia (fluxo de branches, PR, code review)


Habilidades desejáveis:

  • Conhecimento em Nordic (nRF) e/ou STM32
  • Conhecimento em BLE/Wi-Fi, OTA, segurança, consumo de energia, pipelines de build/test



Seu papel será:

  • Arquitetura e desenvolvimento de firmware em C/C++
  • Design e implementação com FreeRTOS (concorrência, sincronização, temporização, prioridades, watchdog, heap/stack tuning)
  • Integração de periféricos e drivers (I2C/SPI/UART/PWM/ADC, etc.)
  • Power management e baixo consumo: estratégias de sleep/deep sleep, definição de wake-up sources, janelas de atividade (acorda/dorme) e gerenciamento do rádio (Wi-Fi/BLE), com medições de consumo, identificação de hotspots e melhorias de autonomia
  • Troubleshooting avançado: investigação de falhas intermitentes, análise de logs e core dumps, diagnóstico de resets/crashes e depuração de concorrência (deadlocks/races), com otimização de heap/stack e performance
  • Processo de engenharia: Git, PRs, revisão de código, padrões e documentação


Diferenciais da vaga:

  • 100% remoto;
  • Participação ativa nos produtos desenvolvidos da área;


Benefícios

  • 100% remoto;
  • VR/VA sem desconto em folha;
  • Convênio médico com coparticipação apenas quando usar;
  • PLR;
  • Seguro de Vida;
  • Totalpass.

title: Desenvolvedor Backend Sênior (.NET / C#)
description:
Desenvolvedor Backend Sênior (.NET / C#)

Modelo: Remoto

Sobre o desafio Buscamos um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) Backend Sênior para atuar em uma squad estratégica responsável por sistemas críticos de pricing, políticas comerciais, descontos escalonados, contas correntes financeiras, conciliações e integrações corporativas. Você irá trabalhar em um ambiente de alta complexidade, alto volume transacional, forte governança, requisitos de auditoria e integrações distribuídas, suportando múltiplos canais digitais B2B (e-commerce, chatbot, APIs, EDI) e sistemas corporativos como SAP, ServiceNow, motores externos de cálculo e plataformas de dados. O papel exige forte capacidade de engenharia, visão sistêmica, responsabilidade técnica e maturidade para operar em ambiente regulado, com foco em performance, resiliência, observabilidade e escalabilidade. Responsabilidades

Desenvolver e evoluir APIs e serviços backend em C# (.NET) para sistemas de pricing, regras comerciais, incentivos, contas correntes e conciliações financeiras.

Atuar no desenho de arquiteturas cloud-native, orientadas a eventos e microsserviços, garantindo escalabilidade, disponibilidade e tolerância a falhas.

Implementar soluções com foco em: o Alta performance e baixa latência o Idempotência, versionamento, snapshots e rastreabilidade o Consistência de dados e integridade transacional o Observabilidade (logs, métricas, tracing distribuído)

Integrar sistemas internos e externos (ex: SAP, plataformas de parceiros, motores de cálculo, mensageria, APIs públicas e privadas).

Trabalhar com bancos relacionais e modelagem de dados complexa (PostgreSQL / SQL Server), incluindo otimização de queries e estratégia de índices.

Garantir padrões de qualidade: o Testes automatizados o Code review o Clean Architecture / SOLID o Segurança e compliance

Atuar em conjunto com Produto, Arquitetura, QA, DevOps e áreas de negócio, participando ativamente de refinamentos técnicos e tomada de decisão.

Apoiar tecnicamente desenvolvedores mais juniores, elevando o nível do time (mentoria técnica).


Requisitos Técnicos Obrigatórios

Experiência sólida como Desenvolvedor Backend Sênior com C# e .NET (.NET Core / .NET 8 e 10) Domínio de: o APIs REST o Microsserviços o Arquitetura em camadas / Clean Architecture o Design Patterns

Experiência comprovada com: o Sistemas de alta performance e alto volume o Processamento assíncrono o Mensageria (SQS e SNS) o Controle de concorrência

Experiência com bancos relacionais: o PostgreSQL e SQL Server o Modelagem relacional complexa o Otimização de queries e performance

Experiência em ambientes cloud AWS o Containers o Observabilidade o Monitoramento o Escalabilidade

Práticas de engenharia: o Testes automatizados o Versionamento (Git) o Code review Diferenciais (Nice to Have)

Experiência com: o Sistemas financeiros, pricing, billing, conciliação, ledger, marketplaces ou e-commerce B2B. o Arquitetura orientada a eventos. o Processamento batch e streaming. o Feature toggles, blue-green deploy, canary release.

Conhecimento em: o Domain-Driven Design (DDD) o Event Sourcing / CQRS o Observabilidade avançada (Datadog, OpenTelemetry).

Vivência em ambientes regulados, auditáveis ou com forte governança. Experiência integrando com ERPs (SAP ou similares).

title: Data Scientist  [Operational Research] - [Banco de Talentos]
description:
Estamos formando um Banco de Talentos para profissionais de Data Science com especialização em Pesquisa Operacional .

O objetivo é identificar talentos para futuras oportunidades voltadas ao desenvolvimento de soluções inteligentes baseadas em dados.


Responsabilidades e atribuições

Implementar o modelo de Pesquisa Operacional, seguindo a especificação técnica definida;

Especificar o método/algoritmo/técnica de Pesquisa Operacional a ser utilizado, considerando o porte típico das instâncias do problema;

Validar a especificação técnica do método/algoritmo de Pesquisa Operacional junto ao cliente responsável;

Gerar relatórios com os resultados da solução do modelo, utilizando o conhecimento dos contratos;

Desenvolver o código do método de Pesquisa Operacional em Python, conforme a especificação aprovada.


Requisitos e qualificações

Conhecimento em modelos matemáticos de Pesquisa Operacional (modelos de programação matemática inteira mista);

Conhecimento avançado em Python nas bibliotecas pandas, openxl, pyinstaller, entre outras;

Conhecimento na biblioteca pyomo para implementação de modelos de PO;

Conhecimento nos solvers HiGHS e GLPK.

Desejáveis: Conhecimento em contratos de transporte de gás natural.

title: Back End Developer
description:
Position: Java Software Engineer (Backend Developer)

Location: Remote (Eastern Standard Time (EST) Hours)

Duration: 12-month contract + extensions


Must Haves:

- 6+ years of backend development experience

- Strong proficiency in Java, Springboot, Microservices, SQL/PostegreSQL

- Knowledge of Google Cloud Platform (GCP)

- Solid understanding of integration architecture and backend services

- Strong debugging, problem-solving, and analytical skills

Plusses:

- POS/Retail Experience

- Triaging/troubleshooting

- Familiarity with Jumpmind or similar POS Technology

Job Description:

Insight Global is hiring a Backend Developer to join our Transaction Team, supporting high impact integration and feature work within our clients POS ecosystem. This role centers on backend engineering with a strong focus on Java-based development, data processing, and fresh feature builds. The ideal candidate is a sharp, analytical engineer who can ramp up quickly and contribute to both new development and production support as needed. This role is primarily focused on new development (80-90%) with occasional involvement in production issue resolution (10-15%).


Exact compensation may vary based on several factors, including skills, experience, and education.


Benefit packages for this role may include healthcare insurance offerings and paid leave as provided by applicable law.

title: US Immigration Paralegal (Employment Based Petitions)
description:
Location: Remote (Work From Home)

Type: Full-Time


Company Description

Beyond Border is a modern immigration platform founded by immigrants, for immigrants, dedicated to supporting U.S. mobility needs for technologists, artists, and skilled professionals. The company's mission is to simplify the immigration process, making it accessible and efficient for individuals and businesses alike. With innovative solutions and expertise, Beyond Border provides comprehensive support throughout the immigration journey to help clients achieve their goals. Learn more about their services at Beyond Border Global.


Role Description

This is a full-time remote position for a Immigration Paralegal specializing in U.S. Employment-Based Petitions. The responsibilities include assisting with the preparation and submission of employment-based visa petitions and other immigration filings, conducting research on immigration law and policies, reviewing and organizing legal documents, and collaborating with attorneys and clients to ensure compliance. The candidate will also provide ongoing support to clients, maintain case management systems, and monitor deadlines and case progress.


Qualifications

  • 2+ years of US O1,EB1,EB2 petition experience with a successful track record of approvals is a must.
  • Strong knowledge of Law, Immigration Law, and Immigration Issues
  • Experience with Visas and Employment-Based Immigration Processes
  • Proficiency in Legal Document Preparation and detail-oriented case management
  • Exceptional organizational, time-management, and written communication skills
  • Ability to work independently and manage multiple deadlines in a remote environment
  • Bachelor’s degree or paralegal certification; prior experience in immigration law is highly preferred

title: Especialista em Integração / Líder Técnico de Integração
description:
Descrição da Vaga

Estamos em busca de Especialistas em Integração / Líderes Técnicos de Integração para atuar no desenho, implementação e liderança técnica de soluções de integração robustas, escaláveis e de alta performance. O profissional será referência técnica para o time, apoiando decisões arquiteturais e boas práticas de desenvolvimento.


Atuação para cliente sediado em Portugal


Responsabilidades

  • Liderar tecnicamente iniciativas de integração entre sistemas e plataformas.
  • Desenhar e implementar arquiteturas baseadas em eventos, mensageria e APIs.
  • Definir padrões, boas práticas e guidelines de integração.
  • Atuar junto às equipes de desenvolvimento para garantir qualidade, performance e escalabilidade.
  • Contribuir para a melhoria contínua dos pipelines de CI/CD e processos de entrega.


Requisitos

  • Graduação ou Mestrado em Engenharia da Computação, Ciência da Computação ou áreas correlatas.
  • Solida de experiência com integrações de sistemas ( Nivel Sr/ especialista +) .
  • Experiência sólida com soluções de streaming e mensageria , como:
  • Kafka, Solace, Pulsar, RabbitMQ ou similares.
  • Experiência com API Gateway e API Management , como:
  • Apigee, Kong, Gravitee ou equivalentes.
  • Experiência com ferramentas de integração , tais como:
  • MuleSoft, Oracle SOA, Apache NiFi, Boomi, Apache Camel, entre outras.
  • Domínio de Git e pipelines de CI/CD , com forte conhecimento em práticas de integração e entrega contínua, visando otimizar processos de desenvolvimento e garantir entregas rápidas e com qualidade.
  • Disponibilidade para atuação remota no fuso horario de Portugal


Diferenciais

  • Atuação prévia como Tech Lead ou Arquiteto de Integração.
  • Experiência em ambientes corporativos de grande escala.
  • Conhecimento em arquiteturas orientadas a eventos (EDA) e microsserviços.
